bio.text: Josh McLaurin, a Democrat, represents Georgia's 14th Senate District; he was sworn in to the Senate on January 9, 2023.
He previously served four years in the Georgia House of Representatives, having been sworn in there on January 14, 2019.

According to his official biography, McLaurin grew up in Cobb County, graduated from the University of Georgia, and received his law degree from Yale; his law practice has focused primarily on business litigation and aviation law.
